newsitem.title: USA: Nu-Tech Bio-Med to acquire Medical Science.
newsitem.headline: Nu-Tech Bio-Med to acquire Medical Science.

text.p: Nu-Tech Bio-Med Inc said Monday that a U.S. Bankruptcy Court had approved a reorganization plan for Medical Science Institute that allows Nu-Tech to acquire Medical Science.

Nu-Tech said the plan was approved by the Bankruptcy Court in the U.S. Central District of California and calls for it to give Medical Science's security holders Nu-Tech common stock valued at about $2 million.
Medical Science is a clinical laboratory business in California with about $12 million in annual revenues and about $1.2 million in annual losses, Nu-Tech said.
